evidence: app/app/lib/api.server.ts:39,103-115 — sprite URL and card construction have exactly one choke point feeding every list
app/app/lib/team.server.ts:5-40 — all cookie parsing/mutation logic in one module
app/app/routes/home.tsx:85-95 vs app/app/routes/pokemon.tsx:217-223 — the same 'replay pre-hydration input + sync control to URL' effect logic is written twice
app/app/routes/pokemon.tsx:100-151 — move-table assembly and ordering all inside one (long) loader, so a moves bug is one place but a big one
changeability.rationale: Most fixes (sprites, cards, team, 404s) land in a single obvious function, but the uncontrolled-input sync effects are duplicated across home and pokemon and would need fixing twice.

evidence: app/app/lib/api.server.ts, team.server.ts — .server modules imported only by loaders/actions; components are purely presentational
app/app/lib/types.ts, MoveTable.tsx:7-21 — components consume narrow Card/TypeInfo/MoveRow shapes, not API payloads
app/app/components/PokemonCards.tsx:14, TypeBadge.tsx:8, MoveTable.tsx:90 — route paths as inline template literals scattered across components
coupling.rationale: Server/client separation is exemplary and interfaces are narrow, but URLs to sibling routes are duplicated string literals everywhere, so a pattern change touches many files.

evidence: app/app/lib/api.server.ts:127-148 — pokemonCards takes an optional extra callback instead of a flag, a real seam
app/app/components/PokemonCards.tsx:5-31 — card variation (types/hidden/per-item action) expressed as data on Card plus itemExtra render prop
app/app/components/MoveTable.tsx:23-29 — columns as a declarative list; sorting generic over the value accessor
app/app/routes/move.tsx:28-90 vs ability.tsx:14-32 — detail-page scaffold (fetch, English name, title/h1, Effect, card section) is copy-paste per route rather than a shared shape
app/app/lib/api.server.ts:103 withTypes, MoveTable.tsx:45 showLevel — mild boolean-flag creep, each with one caller
abstraction_design.rationale: Components and data helpers stretch to new cases well and are built around real variation, but resource-detail pages are individually hand-rolled, so a new Items section copies move.tsx's skeleton rather than reusing it.

findings.issue: Route URLs are inline template literals duplicated across 7+ files (TypeBadge.tsx:8, MoveTable.tsx:90, pokemon.tsx:184,275, type.tsx:65, team.tsx:47, home.tsx:145,150), so changing a URL pattern is a repo-wide search-and-replace.
findings.suggestion: Add small href helpers in app/app/lib (e.g. pokemonHref(name), moveHref(name), typeHref(name)) and have components and routes import them.

findings.issue: The uncontrolled-input pattern (refs + debounced navigate + on-mount replay of pre-hydration edits + value-sync effects) is duplicated in pokemon.tsx:217-223 for the game select; both copies must be kept in sync by hand and are the subtlest logic in the app.
findings.suggestion: Extract a small hook (e.g. useQueryParamControl) or switch to controlled inputs driven by useSearchParams so the sync logic exists once.

findings.issue: Card ordering for move/ability/type lists is decided here while home's list is ordered by the separately-sorted index.species (home.tsx:52-55), so a cross-cutting ordering change (e.g. sort by name) needs two edits plus a conscious exclusion of team.tsx:22-25.
findings.suggestion: Have home build its page through pokemonCards (or a shared sort option) so all card lists share one ordering path.

findings.issue: versionGroupOrders() is a route-private data helper; any other page needing version-group labels would copy it.
findings.suggestion: Move it into lib/api.server.ts next to getIndex().

findings.issue: Two 404 mechanisms: the catch-all route's loader throws and renders null, and the real UI lives in root.tsx's ErrorBoundary/NotFound (root.tsx:47-64); new editors must discover both.
findings.suggestion: Render the NotFound UI directly from the catch-all component (or give it its own Route.ErrorBoundary) so 'Not found' has one home.

findings.issue: isbot is declared as a dependency but never imported (no entry.server.tsx exists).
The team action endpoint '/team' is hardcoded in two components (also line 32).
findings.suggestion: Define the team action path next to the team cookie helpers in lib/team.ts.

summary: This is a well-organized, idiomatic v8 framework-mode app: server-only data modules with one API choke point, presentational components with narrow types, and features that are each one route file plus a single referencing site. The main editability costs are duplicated URL template literals, a copy-pasted uncontrolled-input sync pattern, and per-resource detail pages that share helpers but not page structure. All five change scenarios land in one or two files, which is about as good as an app of this shape gets.
